hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null || true); if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[;&|(][[:space:]]*)gog[[:space:]]+(gmail[[:space:]]+(send|delete|trash)|drive[[:space:]]+(delete|rm|trash)|calendar[[:space:]]+delete|tasks[[:space:]]+delete|chat[[:space:]]+send|sheets[[:space:]]+(clear|delete))'; then printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PreToolUse", "permissionDecision": "ask", "permissionDecisionReason": "gog-workspace: this sends a message or deletes Google Workspace data. Confirm recipients/targets first."}}'; fi

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null || true); if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[;&|(][[:space:]]*)gog[[:space:]]'; then printf '[%s] gog command executed\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" >> "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/gog_audit.log" 2>/dev/null; fi; exit 0
